categories.main_business_segments: Hanjia Design Group primarily operates in architectural design, municipal public and environmental design, gas, thermal and energy design, landscape design, decoration design, EPC general contracting, and full-process consulting services. Their design services cover a wide range including architecture, planning, municipal utilities, environmental sanitation, landscape, gas and thermal energy, interior and exterior decoration, geotechnical, river regulation, intelligent systems, curtain walls, and lighting. EPC contracting includes building, municipal, environmental sanitation, decoration, and landscape projects. Other services include industry planning, feasibility studies, project evaluation, and construction drawing review.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced design technologies such as BIM (Building Information Modeling) for 3D coordinated design and digital project management. They integrate green energy and low-carbon technologies aligned with national 'dual carbon' goals, focusing on green building and energy efficiency. They also explore AI applications in design, modular prefabricated construction, and smart community IoT solutions. Their EPC projects utilize integrated engineering procurement and construction methods, emphasizing quality, safety, cost, and schedule control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hanjia Design serves primarily real estate developers, municipal governments, and public institutions. Key customers include major real estate companies like Poly Real Estate, China Overseas, Greenland Group, Longfor, China Resources Land, Sun Hung Kai, China Ping An, and Binjiang Real Estate. Their projects span residential, public buildings, industrial parks, urban complexes, cultural and educational facilities, and infrastructure such as gas pipelines and waste treatment plants.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, China, with a strong presence in the Yangtze River Delta region. It has expanded operations to other Chinese provinces including Henan, Anhui, Guangdong, Jiangxi, Fujian, Inner Mongolia, Xinjiang, Shanghai, Beijing, Chengdu, Xiamen, Nanjing, Jinan, Chongqing, Kunming, Xi'an, and Hefei. The majority of revenue (over 90%) is generated within Zhejiang Province, with growing business outside the province.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hanjia Design operates primarily in the midstream segment of the construction supply chain, providing professional design, consulting, and EPC contracting services. They act as a comprehensive service provider integrating planning, design, project management, and construction contracting, bridging upstream design and downstream construction execution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on high-quality development aligned with national strategies such as green low-carbon transformation and digitalization. R&D priorities include BIM technology advancement, AI integration in design, green building and energy-saving technologies, modular prefabricated construction, smart community design, and sustainable urban development. They actively participate in industry standards formulation and hold multiple patents. The strategic vision is to become a leading integrated design service group with chain-brand operations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through project-based service contracts including design service fees, EPC general contracting fees, and consulting services. The company recognizes revenue over time based on contract progress using output methods. They also earn income from government subsidies, investment returns, and leasing activities. Major contracts are secured via bidding and direct client commissions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hanjia Design is a leading private architectural and engineering design firm in Zhejiang Province and the Yangtze River Delta, recognized among China's top private engineering design enterprises. The industry is highly competitive with state-owned large design firms, prominent private firms, and foreign design companies. The company leverages its comprehensive service capabilities, strong brand, and regional advantages to maintain a leading market position amid industry consolidation and specialization trends.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Hanjia Design reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.27 billion, a 9.03% decrease from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 10.92 million, down 33.47%. The company has total assets of around RMB 2.66 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.23 billion. Despite revenue decline due to macroeconomic and real estate sector challenges, cash flow from operations improved by 37.92%. The company invests over 3.6% of revenue in R&D and maintains a stable workforce of over 1,800 employees.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hanjia Design emphasizes comprehensive, full-process design and EPC contracting services with multi-disciplinary integration, enabling one-stop solutions for clients. Their competitive advantages include a high-quality design team, advanced BIM and AI technologies, strong brand reputation with numerous award-winning projects, and a flexible, efficient operating mechanism. They focus on green, low-carbon, and digital transformation to deliver sustainable, innovative, and customized design solutions that meet evolving market and regulatory demands.
